hero.headline: EVERY CENT, ON THE RECORD.
hero.sub: Give to people and charities you can check. Your donation waits in a locked account and is paid out in steps, only after donors approve the receipts.
hero.trustNote: Pay by card, Apple Pay or crypto wallet. You can follow every cent until it is spent.
hero.emptyBody: Verified charities and people are preparing their campaigns. Each one will appear here with every donation on the record.

howItWorks.title: How it works

donate.title: You donate
donate.body: By card, Apple Pay or crypto wallet. You get an email receipt and a link to follow your money.

milestones.title: The money is locked
milestones.body: It waits in a locked account. Nobody, including us, can send it anywhere except the campaign, back to donors, or the Emergency Pool.

proof.title: Donors approve, money moves
proof.body: Charities get the money in 3 steps. Each next step is paid only after donors approve the receipts for the last one.

howItWorks.belowNote: If a campaign doesn't reach 10% of its goal, you choose: get your money back, or send it to the Emergency Pool.

charityMarketCap.heading: How does your charity score?
charityMarketCap.description: One public Trust Score for every charity: donor ratings, receipts delivered on time, campaigns that reached their goal. The formula is open. Charities not on CHERR.IO yet are listed too.
charityMarketCap.empty: The ranking appears once organisations have completed their first campaigns and received donor ratings.

emergencyPool.heading: Ready when help can't wait.
emergencyPool.description: Money from campaigns that fell short, and direct gifts, wait here. When an emergency strikes — a natural disaster, an urgent medical need, animals in danger — the donors who gave to the pool vote within 24 hours on which verified campaign receives it.

guardian.title: Chain actions
guardian.intro: Deployed campaigns that wait for CHERR.IO on the blockchain: set the payout plan after a success, decide a vote that did not reach a clear result, deal with a frozen campaign, or step in when nobody finished a campaign or counted a vote for 7 days. The payout plan needs the Operator role and the Guardian decisions the Guardian role; the steps after 7 days can be sent from any admin wallet.

panel.reject: Reject — donors get the rest back
panel.frozenText: A frozen campaign does nothing until a Guardian decides. Unfreezing returns it to the state it was in (an open vote gets its frozen time back); rejecting gives donors the rest of the money back.
panel.freezeText: Use only for a serious problem (fraud report, wrong payout wallet). Everything stops: donations, votes, payments and refunds, until a Guardian decides.
panel.freezeConfirm: I understand that this stops the campaign for everyone.

panel.reverted: The transaction failed on the blockchain. Nothing changed.

panel.noteTooShort: Write a note of at least 10 characters.
panel.fallbackFinalize: The deadline passed more than 7 days ago and nobody finished the campaign. Finishing it counts the result: success when it reached its threshold, otherwise donors can get their money back.
panel.fallbackCloseVote: The vote ended more than 7 days ago and nobody counted it. Counting releases the next payment, rejects, or sends the vote to Guardian review — the contract decides from the votes.
panel.fallbackSweep: The time for donors to claim their refunds is over. What is still in the campaign goes to the Emergency Pool. This cannot be undone.
panel.fallbackAnyWallet: Any wallet can send this; it pays its own network fee (POL).
panel.sweepConfirm: I understand that donors can no longer claim a refund afterwards.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply to everyone who uses CHERR.IO (the website and app at cherr.io and its subdomains). CHERR.IO is operated by Data Vallis d.o.o., a company registered in Slovenia ("we", "us"). By creating an account or donating you agree to these terms.

sections.title: 1. What CHERR.IO is
paragraphs: CHERR.IO is a platform for charitable fundraising on the Polygon blockchain. Verified organisations and verified people publish campaigns; donors give in USDC, a digital dollar.

Every donation goes into a smart contract (an escrow) that belongs to one campaign. The contract — not CHERR.IO — decides where the money may go: to the verified beneficiary, back to donors, or to the shared Emergency Pool. Every donation, payout and vote is public on the blockchain.

sections.title: 2. Your wallet and your keys
paragraphs: When you sign up with email or a social login, a non-custodial wallet is created for you through our wallet provider Privy. You can also connect a wallet you already own. CHERR.IO never holds your funds and cannot move them for you.
Keep access to your login and wallet safe. Blockchain transactions cannot be reversed: a donation sent to a campaign follows the rules of that campaign's contract.

sections.title: 3. Adding money with a card
paragraphs: You can top up your own CHERR.IO wallet with a card through payment partners (for example Stripe or Coinbase). That purchase is a contract between you and the partner, under the partner's terms, fees and identity checks. CHERR.IO is not a party to it, does not receive the payment and does not sell crypto-assets.
The smallest top-up in CHERR.IO is 20 EUR. The partner shows its fee before you pay.

sections.title: 4. Donations, refunds and the Emergency Pool
paragraphs: A campaign succeeds if it raises at least 10 % of its target by its deadline. Then the beneficiary is paid in one payment or in three milestone payments; payments 2 and 3 need evidence and a donor vote.

If a campaign fails, or donors reject a payment, you can claim your share back, or it goes to the Emergency Pool if you chose that when donating. Refunds are not sent automatically: you claim them. Money nobody claims within the campaign's refund period (180 days by default) goes to the Emergency Pool.

Donations are voluntary gifts. CHERR.IO does not guarantee what a beneficiary does with the money, but every step and the evidence are public, and we can freeze a campaign when there is a serious problem.

sections.title: 5. Fees
paragraphs: CHERR.IO takes a 1 % platform fee from money paid out to a beneficiary. It is deducted by the contract at payout. There is no CHERR.IO fee on failed or rejected campaigns, and donors pay no CHERR.IO fee. Network fees are paid by CHERR.IO for wallets created on CHERR.IO; an external wallet pays its own network fee.

sections.title: 6. Organisations and fundraisers
paragraphs: Organisations are verified by our team before they can raise money; individuals go through identity verification. You must give true information and use the money only as described in your campaign.

We do not accept organisations, beneficiaries or campaigns from countries or regions under EU, US or UN sanctions, and we do not accept campaigns for political parties or elections, weapons, gambling, adult content, drugs, financial investments, or anything illegal. We may reject, pause or freeze a campaign that breaks these terms.

sections.title: 7. What you must not do
paragraphs: Do not use CHERR.IO for fraud, money laundering, financing of terrorism or to avoid sanctions; do not impersonate others, upload content you have no right to, or upload personal data of others without their consent. You may not use CHERR.IO if you are subject to sanctions or located in a sanctioned country.

sections.title: 8. Responsibility
paragraphs: CHERR.IO is provided as it is. We work to keep it available and safe, but we are not liable for losses caused by blockchain networks, wallet providers, payment partners, your own lost access, or the actions of beneficiaries, as far as the law allows. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under mandatory consumer law.

sections.title: 9. Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may change these terms; the date at the top shows the current version, and important changes are announced in the app. These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Slovenia.
Contact: Data Vallis d.o.o., Slovenia — hello@cherr.io.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data CHERR.IO collects, why, and what your rights are under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The controller is Data Vallis d.o.o., Slovenia (hello@cherr.io).

sections.title: 1. What we collect
paragraphs: Account: the email address or social login you sign up with, a display name, your choice to donate anonymously, and the wallet addresses linked to your account.

Organisations: the application data and verification documents you upload. Documents are stored encrypted in private storage; only their fingerprints (hashes) can appear on the blockchain, never the documents themselves.
Activity: campaigns, evidence and notes you submit, email preferences, and security records (for example the IP address of admin actions and sign-ins), kept to protect the platform.

sections.title: 2. The blockchain is public
paragraphs: Donations, votes, refunds and payouts are recorded on the Polygon blockchain with the wallet address that made them. These records are public and cannot be changed or deleted by anyone, including us. We never put names, emails or documents on the blockchain. If you donate anonymously, CHERR.IO does not show your name next to your donation.

sections.title: 3. Why we use your data
paragraphs: To run your account and your donations (contract), to verify organisations and prevent fraud and sanctions breaches (legal obligation and legitimate interest), to send service emails about votes and refunds of campaigns you donated to (contract; you can switch them off), and to keep the platform secure (legitimate interest). We do not sell your data and we do not use advertising trackers.

sections.title: 4. Who processes data for us
paragraphs: Privy (sign-in and wallets), Alchemy (blockchain access and network-fee sponsorship), Hetzner (servers and private storage in the EU), and our own mail server for emails. When you add money with a card, the payment partner (for example Stripe or Coinbase) processes your payment and identity data as an independent controller under its own privacy policy.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep it
paragraphs: Account data as long as your account exists. When you delete your account in My account, we delete or anonymise your personal data, except records we must keep by law (for example for verification and accounting) and public blockchain records, which cannot be deleted.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask for access to your data, correction, deletion, restriction, a copy (portability), and you can object to processing based on legitimate interest. Write to hello@cherr.io. You can also complain to the Slovenian Information Commissioner (Informacijski pooblaščenec, www.ip-rs.si) or the authority in your country.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
paragraphs: CHERR.IO uses only the cookies it needs to work: a session cookie that keeps you logged in (7 days) and the cookies of the sign-in provider. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.
